name: The majority voted against a motion: > *That so much of the standing and sessional orders be suspended as would prevent the [Electricity Infrastructure Legislation Amendment Bill 2025](https://www.aph.gov.au/Parliamentary_Business/Bills_Legislation/Bills_Search_Results/Result?bId=r7306), having earlier been referred to the Federation Chamber by way of a programming declaration, being returned to the House immediately, and all debate occurring in this Chamber.* Standing and sessional orders are the usual procedural rules of parliament.
